format.note: double round-robin (22 rounds), then 1st-6th and 7th-12th play another double round-robin (10 rounds). Points from the regular season are halved and rounded down before the split, so the table is not carried forward intact.

notes: 12 clubs, 22 + 10 rounds (32 games). Points are halved and rounded down at the split, which is the key rule for a simulation. Only the last club of the Relegation Round is relegated; the 2. Liga champion is promoted in its place, a straight 1-up/1-down swap with no play-off. The 2. Liga is not in our rows so the league is closed downwards in our data. The separate Conference League play-off after the season decides a European place only and is excluded, as are the cup and European qualification.
